mpf.source: 積金局（MPFA）：僱員強制性供款
mpf.asOf_en: Maximum relevant income $30,000 since 2014-06-01; minimum relevant income $7,100 since 2014-11-01
mpf.note: 積金局正進行 2022–2026 年度的入息上下限法定檢討。據媒體報道，建議把下限調高至 $10,500、上限調高至 $40,000，但截至 2026-10-19 仍未落實。一旦落實，請更新以上兩個數字。
mpf.note_en: The MPFA is carrying out its statutory review of the income limits for 2022–2026. Media reports say the proposal is to raise the minimum to $10,500 and the maximum to $40,000, but as of 2026-10-19 this had not been implemented. Once it is, these figures will be updated.
